'''Alsbet Luhhan''' lives in [[Emond's Field]] with her husband [[Haral Luhhan|Haral]].

== Appearance ==
Her temper is hotter than her husband's and she is nearly as strong as he is.

== Activities==
When the [[trolloc]]s attack [[Emond's Field]] on [[Winternight]], she bravely fights them off with a frying pan and then wanders the village searching for more so she can seek revenge for the destruction to her home.

As part of the Women's circle, she presides over the wedding of [[Perrin]] and [[Faile]].{{ref/book|4|53}}
